Container.Name: unfuckarr
Container.Overview:
Scans a Sonarr/Radarr library, checks every video file is intact and will direct play in Emby, and fixes what is not: transcodes files Emby would have to transcode on every play, remuxes container damage, and deletes and re-searches genuinely broken files (blocklisting the release so the same bad copy is not grabbed again).
Watch folders check new downloads the moment they land, before the *arr imports them. Everything deleted goes to a recycle bin with a retention window, so an automatic decision can be undone.
Web UI shows library status, what it is doing right now, and every setting.
SECURITY: intended to run purely inside a private network or Tailscale tailnet. It deletes and rewrites media unattended, has no auth until an API key is set, and its security has not been independently reviewed by a human - never expose it to the public internet. To pin it to Tailscale, enable this container's Tailscale toggle and set UNFUCKARR_BIND_INTERFACE to tailscale0.
Container.Requires: Sonarr and/or Radarr. Emby is optional but strongly recommended — with it, unfuckarr asks the server itself whether it would direct play each file instead of guessing.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host port for the web interface.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Settings, the file database, and the recycle bin. Keep this on the cache/appdata share.

Config.Name: Media
Config.Description: Your library. Mount it at the SAME path Sonarr/Radarr use, or set path mappings in the settings page — a mismatch makes every file look missing. Read-write is required: transcoding and deleting both write here.

Config.Name: Downloads (watch folder)
Config.Description: Optional. Point this at your completed-downloads folder, then add /downloads as a watch folder in Settings to have new files checked the moment they land.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: Run as this user id. Match your *arr containers or Sonarr will not be able to delete its own files.

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: File mode mask for files unfuckarr creates.

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Timezone, so scheduled scan times read correctly.

Config.Name: Sonarr URL
Config.Description: Optional seed. Set it here or in the settings page. If set, it overrides the saved setting on every start.

Config.Name: Sonarr API key
Config.Description: Optional seed. Sonarr → Settings → General → API Key.

Config.Name: Radarr API key
Config.Description: Optional seed. Radarr → Settings → General → API Key.

Config.Name: Emby API key
Config.Description: Optional seed. Emby → Settings → Advanced → API Keys.

Config.Name: Intel GPU (/dev/dri)
Config.Description: Pass the render node through for QuickSync/VAAPI hardware transcoding. Remove this if the server has no Intel iGPU. Set the matching accelerator in Settings → Transcoding.
